# Camp Resource: Red Games Cupboard

Time to set up for a good ol' board game night. Who get's to pick the first one?

Generates Pre-war board games,

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Red Games Cupboard__

**Produces**

Blast Radius Board Game

Autopsy Board Game

Catch the Commie Board Game

Rad Poker Board Game

Unstoppables! Board Game

*Will count towards Score challenges when taken directly from the collector.

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

All other Game Cupboards

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

5x Wood

**Holds**

6 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.
